_about: Every parameter of the SYNTHETIC data generator (src/boa/synth.py). None of these numbers is estimated from real customs or customer data: each is an ASSUMPTION chosen to give a plausible-looking demo, or ILLUSTRATIVE (a stand-in for a real-world quantity such as an exchange rate). docs/assumptions.md is generated from this file. Changing a value changes every result.

seed.label: ASSUMPTION
seed.about: Seed of numpy.random.default_rng for the whole generator.

n_customers.label: ASSUMPTION
n_customers.about: Number of new customers whose enrolment requests are generated.

enrolment_window.label: ASSUMPTION
enrolment_window.about: Enrolment requests are submitted on uniformly drawn weekdays in this window.

as_of_date.label: ASSUMPTION
as_of_date.about: Snapshot date. Events after it are not generated; open actions are judged overdue against it.

segment_mix.label: ASSUMPTION
segment_mix.about: Share of customers by size segment.

segment_defect_multiplier.label: ASSUMPTION
segment_defect_multiplier.about: Multiplier on every enrolment and document defect probability, by segment.

segment_response_multiplier.label: ASSUMPTION
segment_response_multiplier.about: Multiplier on hold release times (how fast the customer supplies what is missing).

lanes.label: ILLUSTRATIVE
lanes.about: Trade lanes (country pair and mode), their share of customers' primary lanes and a uniform transit-time range in days. Country codes are real ISO 3166 codes; the shares and transit times are invented.

p_primary_lane.label: ASSUMPTION
p_primary_lane.about: Probability that a shipment uses the customer's primary lane; otherwise another lane with the same direction is drawn by weight.

commodities.label: ILLUSTRATIVE
commodities.about: Commodity groups, their share of customers, the HS 2022 subheadings (real codes) a customer of that group trades, and invented unit-price (in the invoice currency) and weight ranges. National 7th-8th digits are drawn from national_suffixes.

product_descriptions.label: ILLUSTRATIVE
product_descriptions.about: Plain-language product names used on synthetic invoices and in hold notes (this project's own wording, not the HS nomenclature text).

national_suffixes.label: ILLUSTRATIVE
national_suffixes.about: Two digits appended to an HS 6-digit code to make an 8-digit code. Invented: the STCCED national split is not used, so these may not be real AHTN codes.

outdated_or_malformed_hs.label: ILLUSTRATIVE
outdated_or_malformed_hs.about: Codes used for the hs_invalid defect: three HS 2017 subheadings that no longer exist in HS 2022 (8517.12, 9405.40, 3002.20) with two zeros appended, a 7-digit code and a 9-digit code.

product_origin.label: ASSUMPTION
product_origin.about: Country of manufacture on the product master: for imports usually the export country, otherwise one of other_import_origins; for exports from Singapore, Singapore-made with probability p_singapore_made_export, otherwise one of export_origins.

p_licence_before_first_shipment.label: ASSUMPTION
p_licence_before_first_shipment.about: Probability that a licence missing at enrolment is obtained before the first shipment (otherwise it is obtained only after a CA_APPROVAL hold, when that hold's corrective action closes).

shipment_cutoff_days_before_as_of.label: ASSUMPTION
shipment_cutoff_days_before_as_of.about: No shipment arrives later than this many days before the snapshot date, so almost every shipment is released by then.

products_per_customer.label: ASSUMPTION
products_per_customer.about: Uniform range of products (HS codes) on a customer's product list.

lines_per_invoice.label: ASSUMPTION
lines_per_invoice.about: Uniform range of invoice lines per shipment.

quantity_per_line.label: ASSUMPTION
quantity_per_line.about: Log-uniform range of the quantity on one invoice line.

incoterm_mix.label: ASSUMPTION
incoterm_mix.about: Incoterms 2020 rule on the commercial invoice.

p_charges_known.label: ASSUMPTION
p_charges_known.about: Singapore imports only: probability that the actual freight and insurance (or, for CFR, the insurance) are on file when a flat rate could stand in for them (FOB from a country in the flat-rate table, or CFR). For every other term that needs charges they are always on file, and for exports to Australia freight and insurance are always shown.

freight_share_of_value.label: ASSUMPTION
freight_share_of_value.about: Uniform range of actual freight as a share of the goods value, by mode.

insurance_share_of_value.label: ASSUMPTION
insurance_share_of_value.about: Uniform range of actual insurance as a share of the goods value.

inland_share_of_value.label: ASSUMPTION
inland_share_of_value.about: Uniform range of inland transport and export handling (EXW) as a share of the goods value.

currency_by_origin.label: ASSUMPTION
currency_by_origin.about: Invoice currency, drawn uniformly from the list for the export country.

fx_to_sgd.label: ILLUSTRATIVE
fx_to_sgd.about: Fixed SGD per unit of currency. NOT the MAS weekly average rates that SG-IMP-10 requires; one fixed rate is used for the whole period.

fx_sgd_to_aud.label: ILLUSTRATIVE
fx_sgd_to_aud.about: Fixed AUD per SGD for the Australian value checks.

p_preference_claimed.label: ASSUMPTION
p_preference_claimed.about: Probability that FTA preference is claimed: on Singapore imports of dutiable lines (wine in this data), and on exports to Australia.

funnel.label: ASSUMPTION
funnel.about: Onboarding funnel: probability of each step and uniform delays in days. An enrolment with blocking validator findings is fixed with probability p_fix_after_findings, otherwise it stalls at 'Documents received'.

enrolment_defects.label: ASSUMPTION
enrolment_defects.about: Probability of each defect in the enrolment bundle (before the segment multiplier). licence_missing_if_controlled applies per competent authority to customers whose products are screened as controlled.

shipment_defects.label: ASSUMPTION
shipment_defects.about: Probability of each latent defect on shipment 1 (before multipliers). licence_missing_if_controlled is the chance of a missing or wrong licence reference when the licence was obtained at enrolment; without a licence on file every screened line is a defect.

sequence_multiplier.label: ASSUMPTION
sequence_multiplier.about: Multiplier on shipment defect probabilities for shipments 1, 2 and 3 (customers and suppliers learn the routine).

recurrence_multiplier_after_action.label: ASSUMPTION
recurrence_multiplier_after_action.about: Multiplier on a defect's probability in later shipments once a corrective action for a hold with that reason was closed before the shipment arrived.

p_hold_given_defect.label: ASSUMPTION
p_hold_given_defect.about: Probability that a latent defect leads to a hold with that reason code.

p_random_inspection.label: ASSUMPTION
p_random_inspection.about: Probability of an INSPECTION hold on a shipment, independent of its documents.

max_holds_per_shipment.label: ASSUMPTION
max_holds_per_shipment.about: At most this many holds are recorded per shipment (the two with the longest expected release time).

release_hours.label: ASSUMPTION
release_hours.about: Hours from hold to release: lognormal with [median, sigma of log] per reason, before mode, destination and segment multipliers.

release_mode_multiplier.label: ASSUMPTION
release_mode_multiplier.about: Multiplier on release hours by mode.

release_destination_multiplier.label: ASSUMPTION
release_destination_multiplier.about: Multiplier on release hours by destination country.

base_clearance_hours.label: ASSUMPTION
base_clearance_hours.about: Hours from arrival to release for a shipment without a hold: lognormal [median, sigma of log] by mode.

hold_start_hours_after_arrival.label: ASSUMPTION
hold_start_hours_after_arrival.about: Uniform range of hours between arrival and the start of a hold.

permit_hours_before_arrival.label: ASSUMPTION
permit_hours_before_arrival.about: Uniform range of hours by which the permit precedes arrival (import) or departure (export); a 'permit_late' defect instead puts it 1-30 hours after.

PERMIT_TIMING: Add permit timing to handling note
PARTY_UEN: Amend or re-apply permit with correct importer
HS_INVALID: Correct HS code and amend permit
CA_APPROVAL: Record licence number in handling note
DOC_MISMATCH: Reconcile invoice, packing list and BL/AWB
BIOSECURITY: Check BICON and obtain permit or treatment certificate

action_types.label: ASSUMPTION
action_types.about: Corrective actions logged for a hold of each reason: the first is always logged, the second with probability p_second_action. Wording follows rules/hold_reasons.csv.

p_second_action.label: ASSUMPTION
p_second_action.about: Probability that a hold also gets the second corrective action of its reason.

action_owner_roles.label: ASSUMPTION
action_owner_roles.about: Roles an action can be assigned to (no person names); the first role owns every optional second action of a hold.

action_owner_by_reason.label: ASSUMPTION
action_owner_by_reason.about: Owner role of the first corrective action of a hold, by reason; the optional second action is always owned by the onboarding analyst.

action_sla_days.label: ASSUMPTION
action_sla_days.about: Calendar days from opening to the due date of every action.

action_close_days.label: ASSUMPTION
action_close_days.about: Days from opening to closing: lognormal [median, sigma of log].

note_noise.label: ASSUMPTION
note_noise.about: Free-text hold note noise: abbreviations (inv, pkg list, frt), one character swap, an appended reference, a sentence mentioning another document in passing, all-lowercase text.
